text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While working out a training schedule to
make the most of summer
camp...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
These two hours after training on this
day—no, two to three
hours—could we
keep this time slot open?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And, just to clarify,
I mean for both of us.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have some... plans, yes. And I,
um... I just
need you to be there.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Would you be willing to help out?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not like her to be so vague.
She looks a
bit nervous, though, so I
decide not to
prod and give her the okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp begins, and we train
according to schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes... Thank you. And, um...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You've remembered to keep two to three
hours open after this...
right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Right,
then please meet me at the shrine in
an hour and thirty-five minutes. I need to
get ready, so I'll meet you there. Bye,
for now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An hour and thirty-five minutes later, I
head to the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Right on time.
I can always count on you to
be punctual.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Not right now, no. Trainer,
are you fond of
festivals?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The summer festival's very lively,
isn't it?
And also... full of delicious
aromas.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It was my roommate who told me that
there'd be a traditional summer
festival
near the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I've been curious about Japanese festivals
ever since coming here.
And, fortunately,
we had some time after training today,
so...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Well,
it's not that I was trying to hide it.
It's just, I wasn't sure when
to tell you, and
kept putting it off.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Surprised... that I'd be interested in
festivals? My roommate also said
as much.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Or, to give a proper quote, "You don't
seem like the noisy
festival-goer type."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, in Germany we have Karnevals, which involve much more noise than this festival. They're wild fun, really.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
During the event,
everyone is free to laugh
and get intoxicated by
the festive mood—I
don't mind it, actually.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And so, since summer festivals are such a
wonderful part of Japanese
culture, I put it
in my schedule to enjoy one to the
fullest. Come on then, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Did you know we have candy apples in
Germany too? Holiday
markets even have
blue apples.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah... They're doing a festival dance over
there. What a fascinating
piece of culture.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
They all look like they're having so much
fun—hm? Wait, are they...
waving to us?
Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh? T-Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We get swept up in the festive mood and
are thoroughly enjoying
ourselves, when...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Oh no, I lost track of the time!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The fireworks will begin three minutes
from now. If we don't hurry...
No, the
probability of making it on time is too
low.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well, you can, but according to what I
found, you can't see all of
them.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So, I found a better spot about ten
minutes from here. If I ran at a jog,
I'd
probably get there in time, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But you...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I forgot my most important goal for the
day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We don't need to move. Change of plans,
we'll watch the fireworks
from here.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm sure. See, the—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
(Just then,
the shrill whistling of fireworks
cuts her off.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Wunderschön... It's so... beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I think this is the best spot after all.
Here, I
get to accomplish my
initial goal...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Having fun with you." That was my top
priority for the day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And I'm... having a lot of fun right now.
Are you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'm happy too—properly
happy.
